comment: Prof Marcin is a super nice lady but the class was really hard for an intro level italian class. There is a lot of Italian compositions you have to write as well as a number of pop quizes. She's very accessible outside of class, but expect to put in more effort than many upper level classes. Again she is really sweet, but tough grader.
Lorenza is amazing! She is so sweet and very laid back - she feels like a second mother! Absolutely take her class!!

One of the best teachers I have ever had. I had taken Italian 6 years prior but the class was still somewhat difficult to me. If you do all the online hw and put a good effort it will improve your grade a lot and help for studying. By the end of a semester she definitely seemed more as a friend than teacher. Take her
Amazing, totally helpful when struggling.  HIGHLY RECOMMEND.  So enthusiastic about her work and everything else going on.

Lorenza is an awesome person and so fun. She's really nice and always makes class super interesting. It is an intensive class so it gets more difficult as the year goes on but it's definitely fine because Lorenza starts off the year strong. She should write a book with all the stories she tells in class. RECOMMEND HIGHLY

Really, really wonderful person and professor. The class is not hard, and downright easy if you have prior experience with Latin, French or Spanish. Lorenza is clear in her explanations, but she makes them in (simple) Italian, so you do have to make an effort. By the end of the semester she will feel like an old friend.

Lorenza is awesome. She's really nice and always makes class interesting. Since it's an intensive class it gets a little more difficult as the year goes on but it's definitely doable. All in all she will make you want to go to Italy with her

LORENZA IS AMAZING!!! I HAD NO PRIOR EXPERIENCE BEFORE TAKING THIS CLASS AND AM LEARNING A TON AND EVEN WANT TO GO TO ITALY WITH HER THIS SUMMER.  IT ISNT THE EASIEST CLASS TO TAKE BUT SHES VERY UNDERSTANDING AND IS THERE TO HELP YOU WHENEVER YOU NEED IT AND GENUINELY WANT YOU TO SUCCEED.  TAKE HER!!!  ps i love her cat stories

Lorenza is really fun and interesting in class, and she has lots of energy. However, her tests get progressively harder (with less and less leeway) and she grades very meticulously on writing assignments. Asking for help outside of class is pointless. Very nice though.

Lorenza made this class. If anyone else had taught it, I don't think I would have enjoyed it as much. I love languages, but this is a very intensive class, with a lot of work and studying required. . . but Lorenza makes it fun and interesting, and loves funny cat stories. Go to class, though. Not mandatory, but it hurts if you miss too much.

I loved lorenza! Though the class is incredibly fast paced, if you keep up on daily work and even have the smallest bit of skill with a language, you'll be able to do well. Tests easy, and homework is looking at what you'll be learning in class the next day. She's super sweet, and is always willing to stop class to tell a personal story.

The 'daily' quizzes don't count, nor are they daily. She's pointing out what you got wrong so you can fix it. She's more than willing to explain herself until you understand. I think the class is incredibly easy, and if you pay attention, or look at the book, you'll be fine.
does not teach, still am not sure where my grade came from, what was up with all of those quizzes?
a quiz every class...wonderful...

One of the nicest people I've ever met.  She took an interest in her students' lives and brought her kids to performances by the music and theatre departments if her students were involved.  She even gave me a recipe for canollis. Also, her class was easy enough that even though I often dozed off (since it was my first class in the morning), I still pulled As.
Quizzes every day...unclear in what she wants...nitpicky grading...class is a total waste of time...horrible...
I always heard how fun and easy Lorenza was.  However by the time I had her, she gave quizzes EVERY class, which most people did very poorly on, and just was unpleasant in general...what happened!?
Lorenza e' simpatichissima!  She's a very wonderful person but her teaching style can be hard for students who aren't used to foreign professors.
Fun classes. She is definetelly the best language professor I ever had, she makes the class much more interesting than it actually is.You will learn a lot about Italian culture too.
